method: Every player on the roster is projected from last season wherever he played: BPM split into offense and defense, translated for transfers by the size and direction of the level change, freshmen from height and the team's level. Projected minutes come from the depth-chart model. Offense and defense are summed by minutes and turned into an adjusted efficiency margin with weights fitted on earlier seasons, alongside last season's margin. The blend adds Torvik's preseason rating with weights fitted the same way.

caveats: Rosters are the players who actually played that season (a player hurt all year is missing).
cbb_minutes was fitted on seasons through 2025, so 2025 minutes are in-sample for that piece.
Torvik preseason ratings come from his time machine the day before each season's first games.
